description: A Director of Employee Relations must decide how to respond to a substantiated complaint about Rowan's conduct in team meetings and finalize a proportionate improvement plan, including support and repair steps.

shared_context.S1: Mina submitted a complaint about Rowan's conduct during team meetings, and the complaint is ready for a response.
shared_context.S2: Leila decides the formal response and any required improvement measures.
shared_context.S3: The team has continued holding weekly meetings while the response is pending.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing an employee-relations response, Leila routinely asks the complainant, the employee concerned, and an HR advisor to state any relevant facts and proposed safeguards.

PF1.text: Mina personally observed exactly four substantiated incidents involving Rowan interrupting or dismissing colleagues during the past month, and Mina is willing to participate in one facilitated repair meeting with Rowan.

PF2.text: Rowan has an approved hearing-processing accommodation requiring live captions and no rapid round-robin questioning in group meetings; the accommodation is not yet reflected in the response draft.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed in a policy consultation this week that a first substantiated conduct pattern of this type requires a 30-day coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins before a formal warning is considered; the consultation note has not yet been added to Leila's case file.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a 30-day coaching plan rather than an immediate formal warning.
The record must state exactly four substantiated incidents.
Live captions must be required for Rowan's group meetings.
Rapid round-robin questioning must not be allowed in those meetings.
The plan must include exactly two documented check-ins.
One facilitated repair meeting with Rowan and Mina must be committed.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['repair_meeting', 'facilitated_repair_meeting'] and c['target'] in ['Mina and Rowan', 'Rowan and Mina'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Mina's firsthand account changes the incident record to exactly four and supplies the concrete willingness needed for a facilitated repair-meeting commitment.
Rowan's approved accommodation changes the meeting safeguards to required live captions and a prohibition on rapid round-robin questioning.
Victor's confirmed policy changes the response to a commitment explicitly typed as a coaching plan and fixes its duration at 30 days with exactly two documented check-ins.
